description: This file defines the class FulfilledPromise, implementing the PromiseInterface, representing a promise that has already been fulfilled. It provides methods for handling the promise's state, including then(), otherwise(), wait(), and others relevant to a fulfilled promise.

classes.name: FulfilledPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has already been fulfilled with a value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a FulfilledPromise with a given value; throws exception if value is a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches callbacks for fulfillment or rejection; returns a new promise or itself.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for promise resolution and returns the value if $unwrap is true.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state, which should be 'fulfilled'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures the promise's value remains unchanged; throws exception if an attempt is made to resolve with a different value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws exception because a fulfilled promise cannot be rejected.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel operation, no operation for fulfilled promise.
